repairs.reason: Match the package-origin bus stroke color and width to the primary connector family
Use a balanced rounded orthogonal turn from the package card into the component trunk
Apply the same connector style and route repair to Korean and English SVG/PNG assets
Replace short post-Q terminal fragments with vertical clearance so every visit connector reaches the card through a visibly rounded orthogonal turn
Replace straight package-to-component fan-out segments with consistent rounded orthogonal elbows in both locales
Double the rendered footprint of yellow dotted secondary heads while preserving machine-readable marker direction and role metadata
Restore the original trunk and card-entry coordinates, changing only each visible branch corner to rounded orthogonal geometry
Remove the split structural bus and encode every package-to-component relationship as one complete rounded connector without overlapping turns
Mirror the visually verified Korean complete connector geometry without reintroducing structural bus overlap
Restore one package-origin link and align all branch curves at x=505 while removing the straight segment that previously overlapped each rounded branch
Split the single package stem into symmetric rounded upper and lower arms at x=505 so the fan-out reads as a radial ㅓ rather than an upward-only merge
Annotate the single radial bus and its five branches so the audit can prove one structural path, symmetric upper and lower arms, and direct Q peel-offs
